body.statement:
Proposition 1 and Sections 5.1--5.3 of Bonhomme, Dano, and Graham characterize
the sharp two-period predetermined-covariate binary-panel model by a
continuous-heterogeneity nonnegative-function program and evaluate the
unrestricted-support version by support grids; they do not supply the finite
joint-response Stieltjes lift stated here.

attestation.note: The published DOI and exact proposition and section locations are supplied; no verbatim source text is reproduced.

body.justification: This supports the theorem's comparison with the published infinite-dimensional feedback program.
body.gap: The finite joint-response and open-half-line certificates are not attributed to the comparator.
body.consumer: It establishes the precise sense in which the exact finite cone replaces the closest published program.
